title: 评估设计影响专家与自动MeSH分类差距：基于Cohen基准的词袋模型与BiomedBERT对比研究
summary: 本研究系统比较了专家标注与自动生成的医学主题词（MeSH）作为分类器特征的效果差异，发现评估设计（如交叉验证折数、语料库大小）会显著影响结论。在Cohen基准上，词袋模型与BiomedBERT的差距在标准评估下约为0.02 WSS@95%，但改变评估设计后差距可能缩小或消失。研究揭示了评估设计对基准结论的关键影响。
summary_en: This study systematically compares expert-assigned vs. auto-generated MeSH terms as classifier features, finding that evaluation design (e.g., cross-validation folds, corpus size) significantly alters conclusions. On the Cohen benchmark, the bag-of-words vs. BiomedBERT gap is ~0.02 WSS@95% under canonical evaluation but shrinks or vanishes under alternative designs, highlighting the critical impact of evaluation design on benchmark conclusions.
